title: CANON Registry — Root File and Entry Schema
description: Validates a CANON-conformant PASS registry file. Governed by CANON.02. Companion artifact to passes/canon/CANON.02.md.

$canon_version.description: Version of the CANON standard this registry conforms to.

namespace.description: The namespace prefix this registry governs. Must match namespace.yaml and conform to CANON.01 R-ID-2.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this registry file was first created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the registry was last modified. Must be updated on every write.

allocation_authority.description: The declared allocation authority for this namespace. Must match namespace.yaml.

namespace_file.description: Relative path to the namespace declaration file (namespace.yaml).

layers_file.description: Relative path to the layers declaration file (layers.yaml).

changelog_file.description: Relative path to the append-only registry changelog.

canon_version.description: Duplicate of $canon_version for tooling that reads meta separately.

known_superseded_dependencies.description: Explicitly acknowledged superseded dependencies. Suppresses WARN for listed entries.

external_registries.description: External namespace registries referenced by depends_on entries in this registry.

registry_url.description: URL or relative file path to the external registry file.

entries.description: Array of canonical ID assignment records. The sole authoritative source for canonical ID assignments in this namespace.

canonical_id.description: A canonical PASS identifier conforming to CANON.01 R-ID-1.

entry.title: CANON Registry Entry
entry.description: A single canonical ID assignment or reservation record.

id.description: The canonical ID. Must conform to CANON.01 R-ID-1. Must be unique within this registry.

alias.description: Primary human-readable name (e.g., ACES.01). Must be unique within namespace. Null permitted for reserved entries only.

legacy_ids.description: Prior identifiers from systems predating CANON. Never null; empty array when none. Values must never be removed.

layer.description: Layer name from the namespace layers declaration file. Use 'unassigned' for reserved entries where layer is not yet determined.

cluster.description: Named cluster this PASS belongs to (e.g., ACES, OG, CANON). Must match alias NAMESPACE-part per CANON.01 R-SP-4. Null for PASSes not in a cluster.

parent.description: Canonical ID of the parent PASS (cluster header). Null for root PASSes.

status.description: Current status of this PASS. Must be one of the declared valid values.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the PASS was accepted or this entry was created.

path.description: Relative path to the PASS document from repository root. Null for reserved entries without a document.

supersedes.description: Canonical IDs this PASS supersedes. Empty array when none.

superseded_by.description: Canonical ID of the PASS that supersedes this one. Non-null only when status is 'superseded'.

depends_on.description: Canonical IDs this PASS depends on. Cross-namespace references permitted.

originating_pass.description: The canonical ID or named form of the PASS that authorized this entry's creation.

description.description: Optional: one or two sentences describing what this PASS governs. Required for cluster header entries.

reserved_for.description: Required when status is 'reserved'. Description of intended future use.

reserved_by.description: Required when status is 'reserved'. Named form or canonical ID of the declaring PASS.

range.description: When a reservation covers a range of IDs: 'NNNN-NNNN'. Present only in reserved entries.

sealed_at.description: Datetime when this PASS was sealed. Present only when status is 'sealed'.

superseded_at.description: Datetime when this PASS was superseded. Present only when status is 'superseded'.
